PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":

          chest_stretch 2m

NUTRITION
  calories: 1600..1800 kcal/day
  protein: 1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight/day
  carbs: 40..45% total calories, focus on low glycaemic index sources (e.g. oats, quinoa, lentils, beans, sweet potato, non-starchy vegetables)
  fats: 25..30% total calories, focus on unsaturated fats (e.g. olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, fatty fish)
  fibre: 25..35g/day, emphasize vegetables, legumes, whole grains
  meal_frequency: 3 main meals + 1..2 snacks/day, consistent timing
  hydration: 2.0..2.5L water/day
  pre_workout: small balanced meal 1..2h before training (e.g. greek yogurt + berries, or whole grain toast + egg)
  post_workout: protein + moderate carb meal within 1h (e.g. chicken + quinoa + vegetables)
  avoid: added sugars, refined grains, sugar-sweetened beverages, high-sodium processed foods
  monitor: blood glucose before and after exercise, adjust carbs if needed for hypoglycaemia risk
  alcohol: limit to 0..1 standard drinks/week
  supplements: consider vitamin D and omega-3 if intake is low
  notes: coordinate meal timing with metformin dosing, avoid skipping meals, prioritize high-fibre, low-GI foods, and monitor for symptoms of hypoglycaemia during/after exercise
